purpose: Verified contract for comparing two verified states of the same property.
comparison_rule: State comparison requires verified property identity and defined endpoint dates/scopes.
difference_rule: A detected difference is distinct from proof of the event that caused it.
causation_rule: Causal attribution requires supporting event/document/legal evidence.
temporal_rule: Each state is anchored to its own date and applicable legal/evidential framework.
interest_rule: Registered title, beneficial interests, security, leasehold, easements, boundaries and other interests are compared independently.
verification_boundary: The comparison identifies supported differences; it does not infer unsupported causal events.
